name: Dinosaur Farm Holidays
accommodation: Five six-berth caravans, each with three bedrooms
suitableFor: Families and groups of up to six
parking: Off-road parking (Visit Isle of Wight listing)
beachAccess: Under a mile to the coast; Compton Bay about five miles (Visit Isle of Wight listing)
confirmedFeatures: Three-bedroom caravans with shower, kitchen equipment, play area, drying facilities, fossil centre on site
overview: Dinosaur Farm Holidays offers five three-bedroom caravans on Lower Sutton Farm, beside the Military Road at Brighstone. The coast is less than a mile away, and Compton Bay is about five miles north-west. The farm also houses a dinosaur fossil centre and runs guided fossil hunts, which suits families on flat days.
surfTripFit: Affordable space for a group of six within a short drive of Compton, with drying facilities for wetsuits.
